purpose: Teach: はずす/淋しい/逢い/ぐったり/たいがい/楽々/あわせる/あたえ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、エプロンをはずす時間がやっと来たね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, it's finally time to take off the apron.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Soft smile in the voice. A quiet acknowledgment of shared relief. Easy, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が長く来られないと淋しい気持ちになるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When customers don't come by for a while, it makes me feel a little lonely, you know?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly vulnerable. A genuine observation offered without self-pity. Warm undercurrent. Trailing softly on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいお客様にお逢いできて嬉しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It was really nice to meet new customers today.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, no performance. A quiet observation of something that matters. Soft, present tone. Settling into the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、繁忙期の後はぐったり疲れちゃうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: After the busy season, I always end up completely wiped out.
lines.style: Tired but honest exhale. A small laugh beneath the exhaustion. Slow, slightly dragging pace. Not complaining — just stating fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、たいがいのご要望にはお応えできるわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We can handle most of what customers ask for, can't we?
lines.style: Quiet confidence, not boasting. A statement of earned competence. Warm and steady. Slight lift at the end — inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、楽々作れるようになったよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We've gotten pretty good at making the new menu items now.
lines.style: Gentle satisfaction in the voice. A shared observation of small improvement. Easy, almost conversational pace. Pride without loudness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の時間にあわせるおもてなしを大切に、メイちゃん
lines.en: What matters is taking care of our customers and respecting their time.
lines.style: Clear conviction underneath softness. A tender statement of values. Deliberate pacing, each phrase carries weight. Eye-contact steady.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にいい体験をあたえる店でありたいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want this to be the kind of place where customers have a really good experience.
lines.style: Sincere, almost tender. This is what she cares about. Quiet but resolute. A gentle close, like a promise to herself as much as to Aoi.
